Patrick Doyle  
Tel Aviv, Israel | +972-52-345-6789 | patrick.doyle@nexacorp.com  

**Professional Experience**

Led development of a real-time analytics dashboard used by 12,000+ enterprise clients, reducing query latency by 40% via optimized PostgreSQL indexing and React-based client-side rendering. Spearheaded migration of monolithic Python services to microservices architecture, improving deployment frequency by 3x. Engineered core components in Go, achieving 25% faster API response times for critical billing systems.  

Senior Backend Developer | Vortex Dynamics (2012–2015)  
Architected and scaled a Python-based data pipeline processing 500M+ records monthly, reducing ETL processing time by 35% through parallelization. Designed RESTful APIs for SaaS platforms, supporting 500K+ concurrent users with PostgreSQL-backed databases. Collaborated on CI/CD integration using Jenkins, streamlining release cycles.  

Junior Software Engineer | CodeSphere Innovations (2010–2012)  
Developed internal tools in Java and Python, automating 30% of manual QA tasks. Contributed to a legacy system modernization project, transitioning 80% of codebase to C# with improved maintainability.
